findings.issue: Spanless log construction inherits ambient SDK context because selected API 1.45.1 LogRecord.__init__ treats empty Context and zero trace identifiers/flags as false and falls back to get_current().
findings.evidence: Under an explicitly attached valid SDK ambient context, all 60 spanless logs carry the ambient trace ID/span ID/flags in real encoded OTLP bytes, while their attempt span remains None and input events have no trace.
findings.qualification: The isolated worker currently creates no active ambient span itself. This finite independent source counterexample establishes a projection-boundary weakness, not an installed facade-reachable context leak.
findings.suggestion: Construct the spanless LogRecord under an explicitly attached empty Context and restore prior context in finally, or pass a truthy context containing only the SDK invalid span if that representation fits the approved contract.

limitations: No facade ContextVar or RPC review is implied; parent owns that boundary.
Actual installed spanless receiver and local-capture correspondence remains a separate gate.
No broader transport, dependency, native workflow, performance, or full C006 qualification.
SDK/provider object memory and abrupt process loss are outside this bounded component evidence.
